_fake_player_count_note: 0 = show the real, live connected player count. Above 0 = always show that fixed number instead.
_backend_transport_note: "raknet" (default) or "nethernet" - which transport this relay uses to reach the backend server. NetherNet backends work end-to-end now (login, resource packs, spawn) - confirmed against Dragonfly. Match whatever the backend actually listens on.
_nethernet_backend_address_note: Only used when backend_transport is "nethernet" - the backend's NetherNet HTTP signaling address. For Dragonfly, this is the same host:port as its regular listen address, not a separate port.
_direct_ip_note: When enabled, players can join by typing this machine's address directly, in addition to the Friends tab. See README's Direct-IP section.
_fix_native_bds_persistence_note: Only turn this on when the backend is a native Bedrock Dedicated Server - it works around a BDS-specific bug where reconnecting players get a fresh, empty save. Leave off for Geyser/Dragonfly/PNX backends.
